paragraphs.text: Ox is a creature type used as a species for most bovine creatures . The creature type can refer to any bovine regardless of whether they are wild or captive. Several other creature types exist for related creatures, including Aurochs , Bison , Minotaur , and the acorn type Cow .

Oxen appear most often in white followed by red and green . Currently, the Beau creature token created by Bonny Pall, Clearcutter is the only blue -aligned ox and no black -aligned oxen have been printed.
The first creatures to bear the type were Wild Ox and Ironhoof Ox in Portal Second Age (though the Raging Bull from Legends was retroactively changed to be an Ox as well).
Mark Rosewater has been been pushing a change to Cow for years, but without any success.
